notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Delayed to 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/0a38c6dd679fc74ad87c5f84d4a15fd72de22ad4.png[/img]
We have decided to delay the launch of Armageddon Onslaught to the first half of 2023. 
We are making numerous changes to the game to increase its quality, this has taken longer than expected as we are also working on Age of Barbarians Chronicles, so we need more time.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/3b066728e9187b410d0289d0a1517356f51d8e00.jpg[/img]

Steam Next Fest has arrived, and with it, the new Armageddon Onslaught demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274810/Armageddon_Onslaught/

Set in a dark and gothic apocalyptic world, are you ready to fight your way through hordes of demons and zombies?
Hurry up and try it out!

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Update #3
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m5xNJLnGDdA;full][/previewyoutube]

Some news about Armageddon Onslaught! The release date of the game has been moved to 10 June 2022.

Armageddon Onslaught has several features, including local multiplayer, bullet time, a dynamic dismemberments system, Metroidvania-like maps to explore, devastating weapons, maidens to save from bloodthirsty demons, a badass soundtrack, and most importantly, kick-ass angelic powers.
We'll try to post a new video of the game as soon as possible.

\m/

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Trailer #2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m5xNJLnGDdA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi guys, we're happy to show you the new Armageddon Onslaught trailer. 
Moreover, we have to announce that we need to move Armageddon Onslaught's release date to a later date (TBD). 
Because we decide to change the game genre to a Metroidvania one, we have to make many enhancements. For this, we need more time.
Another thing, in the trailer we didn't show up any flying sections but they are still presented in the game.
They just weren't ready to be shown.

So, stay tuned!!!






https://www.criansoft.com/

https://www.facebook.com/CrianSoft/

https://twitter.com/CRIANSOFT

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - weapons and gore test
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JeBo4Xxdu3w;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey metalheads, do you want to test some weapons and gore?
From this video, you can have a taste of the new weapons we added to the game. 
Moreover, as you can notice, we improved the characters and enemies' sprites that now look pretty better and detailed.

If you like it don't forget to add it to your wishlist and follow our game updates. \m/

[b]Armageddon Onslaught[/b] will be available for [b]Steam [/b]and [b]Xbox[/b]. The[b] Playstation 5[/b] version will be confirmed soon.

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught - Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/cb168ef6a3afa87ef120a51707707cfd5715938a.gif[/img]

We hope you've had some nice holidays! We start the new year by showing you some new features we added for our upcoming new game Armageddon Onslaught.
As you can see, we decided to add guns to the game, and now the gameplay feeling is completely different, cooler, gory, and badass.
Moreover, you will be able to use angelic powers, but that's another story...
Stay tuned.

notes.title: Armageddon Onslaught at the Steam Game Festival 2020 (Summer Edition)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37682644/ca9111422cc5df07e9a214b8a2cc0b226c9bdf08.jpg[/img]
Armageddon Onslaught will be joining the Steam Game Festival 2020.

The Steam game festival summer edition is coming in June, this event will help game developers like us showcase their upcoming releases!

We will be present at the event and for the occasion, we will release a demo of Armageddon Onslaught.

More updates will coming soon.

Thanks and see you at the Steam Game Festival!
